title: 天文基础模型中的检测通道覆盖像素并导致断层平均红移偏差
summary: 该研究审计了天文基础模型AION-1，发现其训练数据中的目录不完整性导致系统性偏差。通过因果干预，仅修改分割图就使模型输出变化110-4400倍，且模型忽略光分配。缺失检测通道会使断层平均红移偏差超过LSST DESC要求，移除该通道可消除影响且无成本。
summary_en: This study audits the astronomical foundation model AION-1, finding that incompleteness in training catalogs introduces systematic biases. Causal interventions show that editing only the segmentation map changes outputs by 110-4400x, and the model ignores light partitioning. Missing detection channels shift tomographic mean redshifts beyond LSST DESC requirements, but removing the channel eliminates the effect at no cost.
